name: gizza-ai/video-eq-adjust
summary: Adjust a video's brightness, contrast, saturation, and gamma

tool.description: Adjust a video's brightness, contrast, saturation, and gamma in one ffmpeg pass. brightness -1..1 (0=none), contrast 0..4 (1=none), saturation 0..3 (1=none, 0=grayscale), gamma 0.1..10 (1=none). Provide the video as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call). Note: runs on the standalone page and the CLI (chat ffmpeg is unavailable).

brightness.description: Brightness shift from -1 (darker) to 1 (brighter); 0 keeps the original. Example: 0.1.

contrast.description: Contrast multiplier from 0 (flat gray) to 4; 1 keeps the original. Example: 1.2.

gamma.description: Gamma from 0.1 to 10; 1 keeps the original, below 1 brightens midtones. Example: 0.9.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

saturation.description: Color saturation from 0 (grayscale) to 3 (vivid); 1 keeps the original. Example: 1.4.

url.description: Video URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.
